page.overview:
Who is Abraham Lincoln?

President Lincoln was saved from his assassination attempt by John Wilkes Booth thanks to the timely intervention of Wyatt Cenac and Elliott Kalan. Lincoln later became a cyborg ruling the country in a dystopian future.
